Operations Manager Job at Devien Consult Limited




        
    

        
        Devien Consult Limited - Our client, a growing real estate company is recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Operations Manager
Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Real Estate

Job Summary


	We are seeking a results-driven Operations Manager who can oversee the day-to-day business operations and function as the right hand to the CEO.
	The ideal candidate must have strong real estate and sales experience, proven people-management skills, and the ability to drive business growth and operational efficiency.


Job Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Oversee the day-to-day operations of the company, ensuring smooth execution across departments and alignment with business objectives.
	Work closely with the CEO to implement business strategies, improve processes, solve operational challenges and drive company growth.
	Lead and manage the team by setting KPIs, monitoring performance, providing direction and ensuring accountability.
	Drive real estate sales and business development, including lead generation, client acquisition, negotiations, property sales and achievement of revenue targets.
	Monitor business performance, sales activities, expenses and operational efficiency, providing regular reports and actionable recommendations to management.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, property owners, agents, investors and other key stakeholders.
	Identify business opportunities, operational gaps and areas for improvement, and implement solutions that enhance productivity, profitability and customer experience.
	Support recruitment, onboarding, training and performance management to build a high-performing and accountable team.


Job Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Estate Management, Real Estate, Marketing, Management or a related field.
	4–6 years of relevant experience, with significant experience in real estate operations, sales or business development.
	Proven experience managing and leading a team.
	Strong knowledge of the real estate industry and property sales process.
	Demonstrated ability to achieve sales/revenue targets.
	Strong leadership, negotiation, communication and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent business acumen with the ability to think strategically and execute independently.
	Highly organised, proactive, commercially driven and results-oriented.


Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Officer Job at Ascentech Services Limited




        
    

        
        Ascentech Services Limited is a human resources solutions company dedicated to helping businesses build stronger teams and manage people functions more effectively. Established in Nigeria in 2013, we have supported organizations for years with high-quality, practical HR services designed to meet real business needs; adapting to evolving workforce demands and enabling long-term growth. With a strong presence in Lagos and Ibadan, and an expanding footprint through Ascentforce in India, we deliver a broader, more connected approach to recruitment, outsourcing, training, and ongoing HR support. Ascentech brings expertise across borders, backed by over 13 years of dedicated experience in delivering practical HR and recruitment solutions.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Officer 

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Automobile, Oil & Gas, Energy, Engineering & Related Industries

Job Summary


	We are seeking a customer-focused and organized Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Officer to manage customer relationships, maintain accurate customer records, follow up on leads and enquiries, and ensure excellent customer satisfaction.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage and update customer information on the CRM system.
	Handle customer enquiries, requests, and complaints professionally.
	Follow up with prospective and existing customers.
	Track customer interactions, leads, and service requests.
	Liaise with Sales, Service, and Operations teams to resolve customer issues.
	Prepare basic CRM and customer activity reports.
	Support customer retention and relationship management initiatives.


Requirements


	B.Sc. / HND in Business Administration, Marketing, Mass Communication, or a related field.
	2–4 years of relevant experience in CRM, Customer Service, Customer Experience, or a similar role.
	Experience in Automobile, Oil & Gas, Energy, Engineering, or related industries is an advantage.
	Good knowledge of CRM software and Microsoft Office.
	Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
	Strong attention to detail and customer-service orientation.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Backend Developer Job at NoemDek Limited




        
    

        
        NoemDek Limited is an EPC Company incorporated in Nigeria in 2012, to provide specialized services to the Oil & Gas, Power Generation, FMCGs, etc. Over the past five years, the firm and its international partners have supported clients on large infrastructure projects and after-sales services to ensure the assets are maintained effectively and a client’s operations run smoothly.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Backend Developer
Job Location: Lagos

Description
     

            
    




	You will manage the data interchange between the site/software users and servers. Your primary focus areas are to develop the server-side logic, develop and maintain the central database, and ensure high responsiveness and performance to front-end requests.
	The Backend Developer is responsible for integrating the front end, requiring you to have a basic understanding of front-end technologies.
	The Backend Developer must be highly skilled at developing the Application Program Interface (API) and integrating with third-party APIs.
	The candidate will also have experience integrating multiple databases and data sources into a single system.
	To support load changes, you must also be familiar with managing hosting environments, including database administration and application scaling. You should show familiarity with data migration, scripting, transformation, and the setup and administration of backups.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities


	Design, implement and/or use RESTful web services
	Build scalable microservices-based systems
	Understand the needs of the customer or business and utilize this knowledge to develop applications consistent with the customer's specific needs and requests.
	Participate in agile software development, prototyping, testing, and code reviews.
	Write code and libraries that meet the project standards to deliver the desired functionality aligned with the engineering department’s overall standards and guidelines.
	Work with other developers, data scientists, system engineers, and other technical experts to develop and implement solutions, primarily working closely with the front-end developers in building and ensuring synchrony in developing the business’s sites/software and integrating consumer-facing elements through server-side logic.
	Conduct impact assessments and make recommendations in relation to technology choices, design considerations, and strategy implementation.
	Gather and introduce new and relevant technologies and information on documentation practices, scalability, testing techniques, and refactoring.
	Similar duties as assigned by your Head of Department or the CEO.


Requirements


	Proficient in server-side scripting languages (e.g., Node.js, Python, Ruby, PHP).
	Strong knowledge of database management systems (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
	Experience with RESTful API development and integration.
	Familiarity with version control systems, especially Git.
	Understanding of security principles and best practices.
	Analytical and problem-solving mindset.
	Strong communication and collaboration skills.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
	Adaptability to learn and apply new technologies quickly.

They are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Head, Operations

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Managing Director

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Head of Operations to provide strategic leadership and oversight of the company’s operational functions.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring efficient and effective day-to-day operations across the organization, including branch operations, loan processing, customer service, and back-office activities.
	The role will drive operational excellence, process improvement, risk management, regulatory compliance, and the implementation of effective policies and controls. The successful candidate will also monitor operational performance, provide management reports, and collaborate with other departments to achieve the company’s strategic objectives.
	The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of the microfinance industry, excellent leadership capabilities, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and a proven track record of managing complex financial operations.


Key Responsibilities


	Provide strategic leadership and oversight of the company’s operational activities.
	Oversee branch operations, loan processing, customer service, and back-office functions.
	Develop and implement operational policies, procedures, and controls.
	Monitor operational performance and ensure achievement of established targets and KPIs.
	Drive process improvement and operational efficiency across the organization.
	Ensure compliance with applicable microfinance regulations, internal policies, and industry best practices.
	Identify operational risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures.
	Supervise, develop, and motivate operational teams to achieve organizational objectives.
	Prepare and present periodic operational performance reports to Management.
	Ensure effective coordination between Operations and other departments.
	Monitor service delivery standards and drive continuous improvement in customer experience.
	Support the implementation of strategic initiatives aimed at sustainable business growth.


Qualifications & Requirements


	Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 8–10 years of relevant experience in operations management, preferably within the microfinance or financial services sector.
	MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
	Professional certification such as ICAN or ACCA is mandatory.
	Strong knowledge of microfinance operations, regulatory requirements, risk management, and industry best practices.
	Proven experience managing teams and complex operational functions.
	Strong understanding of loan processing and financial services operations.
	Excellent leadership, analytical, communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
	Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
	High level of integrity, professionalism, accountability, and attention to detail.


Method of Application
